Walmart's net income rose about 2.94% from fiscal Q1 2025 to fiscal Q4 2025, based on consolidated net income attributable to Walmart recalled from memory rather than looked up in the filings.

- Fiscal Q1 2025 (quarter ended April 30, 2024): about $5,104 million
- Fiscal Q4 2025 (quarter ended January 31, 2025): about $5,254 million, which is the full-year $19,436 million less the first three quarters

Change: (5,254 − 5,104) / 5,104 ≈ 2.94%.

If you instead use consolidated net income including noncontrolling interests (about $5,307 million to about $5,422 million), the increase is roughly 2.2%.
